register.description: Indicates SoC bootstrap selection. (RW Versions) This register latches the SoC bootstrap pins on the deassertion of power on reset, but unlike MAIN_BOOTCFG it can be overwritten after the initial boot. Note that bootstrap pins are not relatched during exit from Deepsleep because this register is isolated from MAIN domain resets during DeepSleep.

bitfield.description: Specifies the device Primary and Backup boot media. Reset Source: mod_por_rst_n

register.description: Indicates SoC bootstrap selection. (Read Only) This register latches the SoC bootstrap pins on the deassertion of power on reset. Unlike MAIN_DEVSTAT, this register is read only and always reflects the latched value. Note that bootstrap pins are not relatched during exit from Deepsleep because this register is isolated from MAIN domain resets during DeepSleep.
